tools.name: get_creator
tools.description: Get a single Zindies creator (author/artist) by token, with their public creations.

tools.name: get_creation
tools.description: Get a single Zindies creation (zine/publication) by token, with its full creator list, the shops that carry it (places, with address and geo coordinates) and its online shop links (online_links). Use it to answer "where can I buy this zine?". Also returns signed testimonials written by recommenders;

tools.name: list_events
tools.description:
List upcoming and ongoing Zindies events (festivals, fairs, exhibitions).
DayEvent (single-day) and PeriodEvent (multi-day) are unified, distinguished
by event_type. Default range: today through 60 days ahead.

tools.description:

today through 60 days ahead.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_place" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.zindies.co" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_creation, get_place, get_event, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, list_apps · Private data: get_creator, get_creation, get_place, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, list_apps, toggle_favorite, rsvp_event · Public sink: get_creation · Destructive: list_apps.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_creation, get_place, get_event, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, list_apps · Private data: get_creator, get_creation, get_place, list_events_by_place, list_events_by_creator, list_apps, toggle_favorite, rsvp_event · Public sink: get_creation · Destructive: list_apps

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
